# mws_auditlogs_collector (Resource)



## Примеры использования

```terraform
resource "mws_auditlogs_collector" "example" {
  collector_name = var.collector_name

  metadata = {
    display_name = "Example Audit Logs Collector"
  }

  destination = {
    storage = mws_auditlogs_storage.example.id
  }

  enabled = true

  events_sources = []

  services = [
    {
      service = "compute"
      filter  = {}
    },
  ]
}

resource "mws_auditlogs_storage" "example" {
  storage_name = var.storage_name

  retention = {
    period = "30d"
  }
}

variable "collector_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "example-collector"
  description = "Audit logs collector name"
}

variable "storage_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "example-storage"
  description = "Audit logs storage name"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = mws_auditlogs_collector.example
  identity = {
    project        = "<project>"
    collector_name = "<collector_name>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `collector_name` (String)

#### Optional

- `project` (String) Путь к проекту.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = mws_auditlogs_collector.example
  id = "auditlogs/projects/<project>/collectors/<collector_name>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mws_auditlogs_collector.example "auditlogs/projects/<project>/collectors/<collector_name>"
```
